descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT TC-12 ER 5; TFA-92590 AC 6; TFA-94699 AC 1, AC 7 · “Points expire 12 h after they were written.”. Mixed: stated part — Present at 11 h, really deleted at 13 h by the server, a later point kept; our part — Save Note, editor open/close, prior-note import at 11 h and an editor left open across the expiry (only the stated part makes a QA bug).

Bug B19 · excluded (All tickets still in progress / ready for PR (not counted, Quinn 2026-10-14)) · was S1

Retention / purge is not implemented per UAT 3.6: 13-hour Important Points and 37-hour tasks, handoffs and vitals are still there; nothing is purged unless a device opens the app; past 500 patients some charts are skipped

Tickets: TFA-94699 in progress · counts as a QA bug: no (ticket in progress) · found on: local

Note: One root cause behind 19 cases; the windows themselves are decision D6 Re-test 2026-10-20 on 8b4be94a: changed: Important Points now expire per card at 12 h on the server (TFA-92590, TC-12/S05 passes); the window is a code constant (TC-12/S29); 19 h previous note, 37 h open tasks and every other server purge still fail (TC-13/S12, S15, TC-07/S11, TC-17/S23).

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): OAT-04/S01, OAT-04/S04, OAT-04/S07, OAT-04/S08, OAT-04/S11, OAT-04/S14, OAT-04/S15, OAT-04/S17, OAT-04/S23, OAT-04/S24, OAT-04/S26, OAT-04/S27, TC-10/S21, TC-11/S25, TC-13/S15, TC-13/S16, TC-12/S29, TC-13/S29, TC-07/S11, TC-13/S12

Approach · TC-12 Important Points · S05 12 h expiry in both modes: present at 11 h, really deleted at 13 h, not restarted by Save Note, editor open/close or import

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U5 Points expire 12 h after they were written; a point checked 13 h after it was written is gone (Hospital 3.6: Important Points 12 h; TC-12 step 6 repeats it in Nursing Home). … (UAT TC-12; UAT 3.6; TFA-92590 AC 6; TFA-94699 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • U7 Every step is repeated in Nursing Home and must pass in both modes. (UAT TC-12; UAT 3.3; TFA-92590 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • T2 The 12 h Important Points window clears as a real deletion (queryable as gone), not a hidden flag; the window is a configuration value and the purge runs on the server. (TFA-94699 AC 1; TFA-94699 AC 7; UAT 3.6) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • T3 A deleted Important Point never comes back unless the physician enters it again. (TFA-94699 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Hospital patients H1-H7 and Nursing Home residents N1-N4, each with one point written at T0 by server time (H4 / N3 also get a second point at T0+11 h)

When H1 / N1: check at T0+11 h and T0+13 h. H2 / N2: Save Note at T0+11 h. H3: nobody opens the app; server-side read at T0+13 h. H4 / N3: a second point P2 added at T0+11 h. H5 / N4: the editor opened and closed without typing at T0+11 h. H6: Previous Notes > Paste > Save & Extract at T0+11 h. …

Then 11 h: the point is shown and stored. 13 h: gone from the panel and from the database. Hospital: rounding:get importantPoints == [] and importantPointsDraft == ''. Nursing Home: the raw snfResidents doc has importantPoints empty, importantPointsDraft == '' and no admissionSummary.importantPoints. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT TC-12 steps 5-6 and TFA-92590 AC 6 '12 h after they were written'; TFA-94699 AC 1 'queryable as gone' (the raw fields above, not only snf:get), AC 5 (an expired point does not come back from the draft or the editor's copy), AC 7 'purge on the server'. …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method TIME · Time / aging (clock moved); lane planned in the matrix: manual (blocked)

S05 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-12.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row; the Allure status was changed by the triage from passed to failed.

Issue type: Known product issue · environment local · tickets TFA-92590 ready for qa; TFA-94699 in progress

A Hospital Important Point written 13 h ago is still stored and still shown in the pre-round editor: main clears points at 18 h, and Save Note, a prior-note import or opening the editor restart the clock. Nursing Home points never expire.

Evidence: allure 1f69e1d4: all 8 failed cells are known K1 (OAT-04 knownGaps: an 18 h window and one list clock maxed with notesProcessedAt). The NH cells are recorded under TC-12 Q1 / K14. Owners are TFA-92590 AC 6 and TFA-94699 AC 1/2/7, both in progress. The matrix ticket note from Quinn's 10-09 audit lists the same.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: TIME · Time / aging (clock moved); secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-c.
